scenes.say: Ever wondered how Prometheus grabs its metrics? Does it pull, or does it push?

scenes.label: Pull
scenes.sub: Prometheus pulls metrics from each target's endpoint on a schedule.
scenes.say: Prometheus uses a pull model. It regularly scrapes each target's metrics endpoint on its own schedule.
Here's the flow: Prometheus scrapes targets, stores the data as time series, then checks alert rules and sends alerts if needed.

scenes.title: prometheus.yml
scenes.say: In the config, you define which endpoints to scrape. For example, here it targets web zero one on port ninety one hundred.

scenes.question: Does Prometheus push or pull metrics?
scenes.right: It pulls metrics from targets on a schedule.
scenes.say: Don't mix this up: Prometheus doesn't push metrics to targets. It pulls them, which helps it spot downed systems.
